units.source_text: 岛村望着屋檐前招人喜欢的冰柱，同客栈掌柜一起上了汽车。

en.t: Shimamura gazed at the charming icicles hanging from the eaves and got into the car with the innkeeper.

units.source_text: 在雪天夜色的笼罩下，家家户户低矮的屋顶显得越发低矮，仿佛整个村子都静悄悄地沉浸在无底的深渊之中。

en.t: Under the cover of the snowy night, the low roofs of every house seemed lower still, as though the whole village had sunk silently into a bottomless abyss.
